messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired PD#87412 — control-plane fabric heartbeat loss detected in region az3. severity=P1. auto-escalate in 5m if unacked
raj: ack PD#87412 — I'm oncall, taking initial triage
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Alert acknowledged by raj
emma: telemetry shows ~60% of serving replicas in az3 reported Unhealthy within last 2m. errors & 5xx up, looks like control-plane stopped accepting heartbeats :eyes:
luca: confirmed from metrics: serving_replicas.az3 dropped 240 -> 92 in 3m, endpoint error rate x8, p95 latency jumped to 500ms
olivia: ops: support seeing 502/504 spikes for EU customers, some sessions still sticky to az3 due to routing cookie — ticket volume climbing
raj: running quick connectivity checks to control-plane leader in az3 — pings timing out, pulling logs now
raj: controller logs tail:
```
2026-03-15T10:12:03Z controller: lost heartbeat from fabric-agent az3-node-12
2026-03-15T10:12:07Z controller: shard eviction initiated for az3
2026-03-15T10:12:10Z controller: control-plane heartbeat failed, route-manager -> degraded
```
emma: @networking-bot can you surface any fabric/spine issues? last fabric change at ~10:11Z per infra-alerts
networking-bot: NOC alert: BGP/leaf flap between az3-leaf-2 and backbone-1. AS path changes observed. Provider engaged
luca: immediate mitigation: divert traffic off az3 to az1/az2 and warm caches on targets. also throttle/ reduce batch sizes for consumers to avoid hot-spotting
raj: executing traffic-divert runbook now — applying temp weights:
```
traffic-policy apply --from=az3 --to=az2=0.7,az1=0.3 --note "az3 fabric heartbeat loss"
```
olivia: drafting support blurb: "We are diverting traffic from an affected zone; customers may see increased latency while we mitigate." will hold public post until we confirm stabilization
maria: prepping to take lead at 10:18Z — stand by for handoff
raj: started region-fallback job rf-20260315-01 per runbook step 4
oncall-bot: region-fallback job rf-20260315-01 initiated
luca: watch az2 inbound QPS — already +45%. autoscaler firing but monitor CPU and queue length closely
emma: kicking prefix-cache rehydration on az2 to warm KV caches:
```
rehydrate-cache --region az2 --shards all --parallel 6
```
olivia: support: tagging top EU customers for potential outreach. ETA for public status update 10:30Z
networking-bot: NOC: provider investigating fabric control-plane instability; expected 10-15m for remediation
raj: PD escalation window in ~8m — if not degrading, escalate to SRE lead + infra
luca: mitigation checklist (live): divert traffic (done), throttle batch sizes (in progress), warm caches (in progress), notify sales/support (olivia), prepare heap/profile if controller responds
maria: taking over lead at 10:18Z. raj, any outstanding ops for you?
raj: I'll keep collecting controller logs and packet captures. handing active commands to maria
maria: ack. creating live incident doc https://intranet.docs/incident/87412 (internal)
emma: autoscaler tune: temporarily raise scale-down threshold to 0.85 to reduce churn while shifting traffic
luca: patched autoscaler thresholds for az1/az2 pools
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: alert escalated to SRE lead
oncall-bot: autopager suppression enabled while mitigation active
olivia: support: drafted public status; holding until we confirm reduced customer impact
networking-bot: NOC: provider reports partial stabilization of fabric control-plane at 10:25Z; still monitoring
maria: az3 error-rate trending down but nonzero. keeping traffic diverted until +10m of steady heartbeats
raj: post-divert snapshot: errors az3 down ~70%, az2 latency ~220ms, no further PD escalations
emma: initiating controlled shard evac from az3 to az2 per runbook step 7
luca: prepare rollback path if az2/az1 overload: set weights az2=0.5,az1=0.5 and enable throttling of non-critical endpoints
maria: executive one-liner: "P1: control-plane fabric heartbeat loss in az3. traffic diverted to az1/az2. Some EU API errors/latency; mitigation active. Eng lead & provider collaborating."
olivia: posting public status: "Partial outage impacting API requests in EU due to az3 control-plane fabric issue. Mitigation in progress." :mega:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: timeline note added by maria
maria: assigning postmortem to eng-runtime + networking teams; will capture timeline and RCA follow-ups
oncall-bot: incident-bot: active — not resolved. last action at 10:27Z
luca: observed slow cache rehydration; increasing parallelism to 8
emma: rehydration 65% -> 98% over next window
maria: planning handoff to night shift at 10:30Z if still active; otherwise transition to recovery
olivia: support comms updated with FAQ and customer link
networking-bot: NOC: provider confirms control-plane fabric stable at 10:36Z; asking us to verify heartbeats
raj: az3 heartbeats restored at 10:38Z. beginning cautious traffic re-introduction:
```
traffic-policy apply --weights az2=0.6,az1=0.3,az3=0.1 --note "controlled re-intro after fabric stabilizes"
```
luca: monitoring CPU, queue length, and p95 latencies closely for az3 ramp
emma: caches rehydrated 98% — KV warm
maria: will ramp az3 to 30% over next 10m if metrics remain stable
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: incident in recovery phase; acknowledged by oncall-lead
olivia: preparing final customer update once recovery holds for 30m
maria: preliminary classification: controlled failover due to az3 fabric/control-plane heartbeat loss. automated divert and fallback worked; follow-ups: routing cookie TTLs, autoscaler thresholds, provider SLA follow-up
oncall-bot: incident-bot: last log updated 1768485480
